info.name: Learning Assistant API (Team 08)
info.description:
Team 08 Learning Assistant — Cloudflare Worker (Hono + D1 + Workers AI).

**Run order matters:** folders are numbered and later requests reuse ids saved by earlier ones (sourceId, questionId, answerId). Use the Collection Runner, or send them top to bottom.

**Before running**
1. Start the API: `npm run db:migrate:local && npm run dev:local` (local D1 + real Workers AI), or `npx wrangler dev --local` (no AI; answers use the keyword fallback).
2. Set `baseUrl` to the port wrangler prints (default `http://localhost:8787`; `8788` if 8787 was busy).
3. `webhookSecret` and `integrationTestKey` must equal `INTERNSHIP_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `INTEGRATION_TEST_KEY` in your `.dev.vars`. The defaults here are local-only placeholders — never put real secrets in this file.

**Identity:** deployments use Student Identity (Team 01) sign-in — run folder 0 first (see its description); each request then carries the Bearer token of the account it acts as. Local `npm run dev:local` uses demo-headers mode, where the `x-user-id` / `x-user-role` headers are enough.

**Costs:** "Ask a question" and "Deep health with AI probe" make real Workers AI calls against your free daily allocation. "Team 17 test-send" posts to Team 17's live server — it is excluded from routine runs.

item.name: 0. Sign in (Student Identity — deployments only)
item.description: Deployments use Student Identity (Team 01) sign-in. Set `studentId`, `otherStudentId` and `instructorId` to three real Student Identity student IDs, and their passwords in `studentPassword`, `otherStudentPassword`, `instructorPassword` — in a Postman environment's current value, never in this file. The instructor account must have the instructor/staff/admin role in Student Identity or be listed in the server's INSTRUCTOR_IDS. Requests without a password set are skipped (local demo-headers mode needs none of this).
